title: feat(nm2splt2x): 1-in 2-out at t vs t+1 on two-axis opposite x-probes: reverse fails, face fails, composition fail
science: Split t vs t+1 on opposite x-probes: fail/fail at both cuts, composition fail because split at B and C flips fail->HOLD when O fills. Records that |Axis(M)|=1 at every probe at both cuts, so split coincides with cover on this cell.
